scope: Fitter checkpoint selection and bounded follow-up search; original photographs, automatic crops, classified masks and acceptance gates unchanged. This ledger distinguishes search budgets, complete image acceptance, editable replay and browser interaction.

regular.timing: Preparation + solve + validation + export; decode and independent replay excluded.

hard.codeProvenance: Dataset and editable runs use checkpoint fix 4723115/5a760c5 before continuation cap bcf4bed. The cap only shortens allowances above 25 seconds, so these <=25-second run deadlines are unchanged. Required checks and normal 180-second browser replays use the final cap and renderer optimization e474ad7.

controlled.qualification: Extra 600-step continuations are diagnostic only. Paper resolution changes the guarded fitting margin; splitting changes regularizer sampling. Only the fine audit of unchanged retained checkpoint coordinates isolates the shipped rejection cause.

normal.timingMethod: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.

intervention.method: HTTP source override: block the actual compute worker for 30 s before fitting (empty), or immediately after a real validated checkpoint with error <= 0.6% (keep), or finer paper resolution 700 and original-image error <= 3% (keep-finer), or the new detail-polishing stage with resolution 700 and original-image error <= 2.6% (keep-detail). Cancel-finishing additionally yields for 2 s in finalization. No geometry, counts or seed is supplied.

interruptedPreCapBrowser.reason: Stopped after five successful Chromium cases exposed excessive extra routing, before completed WebKit release QA.

rendererOptimization.method: Same path-only SVG at both font settings, in both orders; all PNG bytes identical.
